dependency_audit.axiom_summary: Halpern–Läuchli and the finite/countable compactness tree are ZF arguments with coded finite choices. The basic Cohen and Feferman target models are internally ZF; AC occurs only in their declared metatheoretic forcing sources. Solovay's ambient construction is ZFC plus an inaccessible; HOD(S) and L(R) are internally ZF+DC. Ambient AC is used in forcing/Boolean completions, generic-code enumeration, HOD(S) code selection, the real-witness stage of the L(R) DC recursion, and proof compilation. Internally, DC supplies exactly the countable choice required by the published finite-product Lebesgue-measure interface; it is not promoted to full AC.
